name: Micro Practice Model v2
purpose: Define short, action-first practice units that are distinct from session modes, communicative skills, language resources and authoritative evidence.
principles: Micro-practice is for learning; integrated tasks are for demonstrating.
Feedback is immediate whenever the activity can be evaluated deterministically.
The learner should act before navigating to another screen.
Spanish is support, not the target language of production.
A session may mix skills and activity types.
Micro-practice does not directly mutate Can-Do mastery unless explicitly marked as evidence-producing.

modes.mixed: Adaptive mixture of activity types and skills.

evidenceRule: Micro-practice contributes diagnostic signals; Can-Do status changes through the existing Evidence Boundary and Learning Engine.

mixed: include at least one communicative activity when available
include a demonstration when the session is evidence-producing
review: vary activity type after repeated failure
focus: respect the requested skill or resource
do not silently convert a resource focus into a different skill
